title: Agreeing documents
caption: Prepare documents for a hearing
inset: You may have been told in an order from the tribunal to work with the other party to agree on the documents that will be relied upon at the hearing.

bundlesRespondentAgreedDocWith.label: Have you agreed these documents with the other party?
bundlesRespondentAgreedDocWith.agreedBut: We have agreed but there are some disputed documents
bundlesRespondentAgreedDocWith.notAgreed: No, we have not agreed and I want to provide my own documents

bundlesRespondentAgreedDocWithBut.label: Tell us which documents are disputed

bundlesRespondentAgreedDocWithNo.label: Tell us why you've not been able to agree with the other party

bundlesRespondentAgreedDocWith.required: Tell us if you have agreed these documents with the other party

bundlesRespondentAgreedDocWithBut.required: Tell us which documents are disputed
bundlesRespondentAgreedDocWithBut.tooLong: Tell us which documents are disputed must be entered as less than 2500 characters

bundlesRespondentAgreedDocWithNo.required: Tell us why you've not been able to agree with the other party
bundlesRespondentAgreedDocWithNo.tooLong: Tell us why you've not been able to agree with the other party must be entered as less than 2500 characters
